Official macro data

US inflation & labour indicators

Five series from the US Bureau of Labor Statistics Public Data API v1. Values are published historical observations with their own index bases and units; they are not live market quotes or a complete economic calendar.

BLS macro dashboard

API cache refreshes on demand and expires after six hours.

Method and limitations

Version 1 of the BLS API is public without registration, with a documented limit of 25 series per request and up to 10 years of observations. It returns historical observations and can lag the original release; release time/calendar data are separate. Do not combine different index base units or infer market direction from a single series.
